measurement: One worker per equation runs the Zoo record builder: local dimension, embedded resolution with both zetas and the pole check, intrinsic resolution, an exhaustive pole-check replay when the quick check is unresolved, then the Milnor and Tjurina numbers. The 20-second wall-clock budget covers every step, and each equation ran once. Six equations ran at once on an Intel Core i7-1355U (10 cores, 12 threads). A certified case has complete geometry in both modes, both zetas and a verified pole check.

families.S01: Central plane arrangements, one per intersection lattice
families.S02: Cones over classical plane curves and over curves z^(d-m) g_m + g_d with a prescribed singular point
families.S03: Three or four smooth sheets z = p_i(x, y) with prescribed contact
families.S04: Images of finite map germs (C², 0) → (C³, 0): Mond's simple germs, triple and quadruple points, corank 2
families.S05: Discriminants and caustics: swallowtail, sections of the A4 and A5 discriminants, B3, umbilic, D5 and E6 caustics
families.S06: Ruled families b(x, y) + z^k a(x, y) of binary forms: moving cross-ratio or multiplicity jump
families.S07: Transverse D, E, W and Z curve germs along a singular plane curve
families.S08: Transverse type along a singular plane curve that degenerates at the origin: h^j + z^k m(x, y)
families.S09: Singular along a complete-intersection space curve
families.S10: Quasi-ordinary surfaces with two characteristic exponents
families.S11: Tangent developables of monomial space curves
families.S12: Steiner-type surfaces: three singular axes with a triple-point term
families.S13: A cylinder over a plane curve together with a smooth sheet
families.S14: Non-isolated chain trinomials x^a y^b + y^c z^d + z^e
families.S15: Random non-convenient Newton polyhedra, singular along one or two axes
families.S16: Lines of exceptional and parabolic curve germs with the modulus as coordinate
families.T02: Compound Du Val threefolds, including Laufer's flops
families.T03: Threefold cusps x^p + y^q + z^r + t^s + xyzt
families.T04: Joins g(x, y) + h(z, t) of two plane curve germs
families.T05: Convenient Newton polyhedra with interior mixed monomials
families.T06: Superisolated threefolds C_d + L^(d+1) over cubic and quartic surfaces with isolated singular points
families.T07: Invertible polynomials: chain, loop and Fermat blocks
families.T08: Cones over smooth cubic, quartic and quintic surfaces
families.T09: Lines of exceptional unimodal surface germs with the modulus as coordinate; Briançon–Speder
families.T10: Central hyperplane arrangements in C⁴, one per intersection lattice; the D4 reflection arrangement
families.T11: Discriminants and caustics in C⁴: A4, B4, sections of A5, D4, D5 and E6
families.T12: Images of map germs (C³, 0) → (C⁴, 0): double, triple and corank-2 types
families.T13: Cones over singular surfaces: Roman surface, Cayley cubic, t^(d-m) g_m + g_d
families.T14: A singular plane whose transverse type jumps along a plane curve: A + B·h(z, t)
families.T15: Smooth sheets t = p_i(x, y, z), and unions with isolated threefolds
families.T16: Non-isolated chain quadrinomials x^a y^b + y^c z^d + z^e t^f + t^g
families.T17: Random non-convenient Newton polyhedra, singular along a line or a plane
families.T18: Joins of a non-reduced plane curve with a plane curve
families.T19: Suspensions f(x, y, z) + t^m of surfaces from this screen
